scripts.check: bun run check:pi-control && bun run check:pi-suppress-providers
scripts.test: bun --cwd packages/pi-control test && bun --cwd packages/pi-suppress-providers test
scripts.lint: (cd packages/pi-control && bun run lint) && (cd packages/pi-suppress-providers && bun run lint)
scripts.format: (cd packages/pi-control && bun run format) && (cd packages/pi-suppress-providers && bun run format)
scripts.format:check: (cd packages/pi-control && bun run format:check) && (cd packages/pi-suppress-providers && bun run format:check)
